title: Unit Event — Live with Memories — Episode2 Estranged Brother and Sister

meta.Event Outline: The wind is in Leo/need's sails as the band continues performing and starts to build its own fanbase. But then, they encounter a brother and sister, who are Leo/need fans, having an argument.

rows.Line: Outside the live house

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Those two that are arguing... Aren't they...?
Ugh... I'm done talking to you!!
Hanano!!

...!
I-I'm so sorry!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait...!

Hanano!
We're not done talk... Wah!
se_event_memories_2022_003

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Watch out! That car's going to...!
se_event_memories_2022_004

rows.Speaker: Driver
rows.Line: What did you do that for?! Are you nuts?!

I-I'm sorry!
Ow...
se_event_memories_2022_002

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Are you okay?!

Oh, sorry about that... But I'm okay.
I just scraped my elbow a little by trying to dodge that car...
Wait, aren't you from Leo/need...?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh no! Your elbow!
The blood is seeping through your clothes too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Wh-What do we do...?!
We need to treat you somehow...!

No, that's okay!
I don't want to be any more of a bother...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, you won't be a bother.
Let's just get you cleaned up first...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho, does the live house have a first aid kit? We'd only need a couple of things to properly treat him.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, there should be one.
I'll go get it now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That and... We should find a place for him to sit! Know any good spots nearby?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, let's try the park!
Can you stand?
Th-Thank you very much...
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
There...
All cleaned up.

Thank you.
I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Nothing broke as far as I could tell, but it still might be a good idea to have someone at the hospital look at it...
Okay.

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line:
Um... You're Leo/need, right?
It's nice to meet you. My name's Yota Yoshizaki. I'm always at your shows and really enjoy hearing you play.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh... Th-Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: You're all probably really tired after finishing that show... So, thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, it's okay.
You don't need to thank us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Honestly, we should be the ones thanking you two for always coming to see our shows!

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line:
Huh?
For always... Wait, you recognize us?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. You two are always at the front, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You both always look like you're really enjoying yourselves, so it was hard not to notice.

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: I never would've guessed...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: I can't believe you remembered who we are. My little sister's going to be ecstatic when she hears that Leo/need knows who we are...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: Um... I know that this is asking a lot...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: But if my little sister comes and sees your next show, would you mind talking to her for me...?

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: She's still in junior high, so I'd really like it if she's with someone she knows when she goes to the live house...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Wait, what are you saying...?
You're always with her...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line:
The thing is...
I won't be able to go to any more shows.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What? Why not...?

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: I'm trying to stay away from her...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Did something happen between you two?

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: Our parents got divorced...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line:
I-I'm sorry...!
I know it's a personal matter and not something I should be discussing with others...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: But Hanano and I have been living away from each other ever since the divorce was finalized last year...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line:
Yes, but...
We're both worried about each other's home lives, so we've been meeting a few times per month like this.

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: That was when we learned about your band...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: The divorce left Hanano in a really bad place, but she's been much happier ever since she started attending your shows.

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: Apparently, your music speaks to her by saying, “You're not alone. Let's get through this together.” Oh, needless to say, I'm a big fan too...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You are...?!
Hehe. Thank you so much!
We're really glad to hear that!

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line:
Same here.
Especially since Hanano's been having so much fun going to your shows.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That explains why you two are always at the front.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But they like hanging out with each other despite having to live apart... How does that lead to him not wanting to meet anymore...?)

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: For a while, we didn't have any problems seeing each other...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: But about six months ago, our dad remarried and wound up starting a new family...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A new family...?

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: Hanano began to think that she didn't belong at home anymore and asked me if we could start meeting more often...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's so rough...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: It really is. I'm sure they're not bad people or anything, but Hanano just doesn't feel comfortable knowing that she's living with strangers...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: Initially, I thought I could keep an eye on her while she adjusted to her new life.

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: But as time passed, we began seeing each other more often...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: And just the other day, after I suggested that she spent more time with her new family, she said, “I don't need my new family because I have you, Yota.”

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: That was when I realized that she won't try to get along with her new family as long as her old one's around... Including me...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: I want to help support Hanano, but realistically, I can't be there for her forever...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: In terms of what's best for her future, I feel like she needs to learn to get along with her new family.

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line:
Which is why...
Today, I said, “We need to stop meeting like this.”

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Is that why...?
You big dummy...!!

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: I was just trying to ask her to get to know her new family better, but I guess it didn't come out right...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (They ended up fighting because they couldn't tell each other how they really feel...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (That's so...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (That's so sad...)

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: Anyway, thank you for helping me out the way you did today. Also, sorry for making you listening to my life story even though it's our first time meeting.

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line:
So... Good luck with your shows.
I'll come back once things have settled down.

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: Now, if you'll excuse me.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: W-Wait...!

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Um, so...
I know you two ended up arguing today...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I hope you and your sister find a solution because it's awful seeing you two get torn from each other like this...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line:
Right. Thank you...
I'll try talking things over with her again.

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: Once we've come to an agreement, I'll make sure to never see her...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: Never see her... Again...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line:
Sorry, I should get going...
Thank you all again for what you've done.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: He's willing to not see her for the sake of her future... He seems to really care about his sister...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, but...
He seemed really sad too...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Isn't there anything we can do for them...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But this is someone's family we're talking about. I'm not sure we're in a position to say anything...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So... There's nothing we can do...?
